{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Water| type2=Ice| trainername=Lorelei| pokemonname=Cloyster| jtrainername=カンナ| jpokemonname=パルシェン| tmtrainername=Kanna| tmpokemonname=Parshen| image=[[File:Lorelei Cloyster Adventures.png|210px]]| caption=Lorelei's Cloyster| epnum=PS044| epname=Do Wrong, Dewgong!| prevonum=091| noevo=incap | ability={{a|Shell Armor}} (Games)| current=[[Party|With Lorelei]]| java1=[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]| enva1=[[Michael Haigney]]| }} '''Lorelei's Cloyster''' (Japanese: '''カンナのパルシェン''' ''Kanna's Parshen''; known in the {{aniseries|PTS}} [[dub]] as '''Prima's Cloyster''') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Lorelei]] in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. ==In the manga== ===In the Pokémon Adventures manga=== ===={{MangaArc|Yellow}}==== [[File:Lorelei and Cloyster Adventures.png|thumb|220px|left|Cloyster and Lorelei]] Lorelei's Cloyster is one of her main Pokémon. It first appeared along with her {{p|Dewgong}} in ''[[PS044|Do Wrong, Dewgong!]]''. Cloyster traps {{adv|Yellow}} and {{adv|Bill}} in a cave by collapsing the entrance with a {{m|Spike Cannon}}. When Yellow tries to escape, Cloyster sends an {{m|Ice Beam}}-powered Spike Cannon which stops them. Eventually, they do escape and Yellow attacks with [[Pika]], with it using {{m|Thunder Shock}}. Lorelei tells Cloyster to {{m|Withdraw}} into its shell and Pika's ThunderShock bounces off harmlessly, though it became too stunned to move. After a long chase, Lorelei gets Cloyster to {{m|Aurora Beam}} Yellow and Bill, {{status|Freeze|freezing}} them in place along with an entire tidal wave. Then, Lorelei tries to extract information from Yellow by getting Cloyster to bombard them with its {{m|Supersonic}}, [[Ratty|Yellow's Rattata]] comes and rescues them at the last minute with its {{m|Super Fang}}. In ''[[PS073|Valiant Venomoth!]]'', Lorelei appears again, this time riding in her Cloyster, to battle {{adv|Green}} and [[Sabrina]]. She uses voodoo dolls made from her {{p|Jynx}} to freeze their hands together and present the threat that any part of the dolls that are destroyed means they will, too. Cloyster then uses {{m|Ice Beam}} on them, but it barely misses them. Green sends out [[Green (Adventures)#Nidory|Nidorina]] and Sabrina uses {{p|Venomoth}}. Nidorina {{m|Take Down|charges}} at Cloyster and Venomoth uses {{m|Sleep Powder}}. Cloyster uses {{m|Blizzard}} to blow the Sleep Powder into Nidorina's face which puts her to sleep. Venomoth charges again and again, with Cloyster withdrawing each time so that all the attacks don't hit. Eventually Cloyster falls over, fainted, and Lorelei then realizes that it had been using {{m|Mega Drain}} the whole time. Cloyster also makes a small appearance getting defeated by a {{p|Blastoise}}'s {{m|Hydro Pump}} in ''[[PS084|Clefabulous Clefable]]''. ===={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}==== When Lorelei later reappeared in the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}, she used Cloyster again to defeat countless {{p|Unown}} with another Spike Cannon blast, but was taken by surprise when [[Sird]]'s {{p|Starmie}} used {{m|Camouflage}} to approach them whilst disguised as part of the terrain before it defeated both Cloyster and Lorelei with a {{m|Hyper Beam}}. ===Personality and characteristics=== Cloyster has no problem in following Lorelei's commands as shown when she relied on it in order to do dangerous tasks and to prevent anyone from interfering with her plans. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|Water|Ice|Lorelei Cloyster {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Spike Cannon|1=Withdraw|2=Aurora Beam}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Spike Cannon|1=Withdraw|2=Aurora Beam}}|image2=Lorelei Cloyster {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Supersonic|1=Ice Beam|2=Blizzard}} Adventures.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Supersonic|1=Ice Beam|2=Blizzard}}}} {{anmov|normal|Spike Cannon|PS045|Cloystered|rec=yes}} {{anmov|water|Withdraw|PS045|Cloystered}} {{anmov|ice|Aurora Beam|PS045|Cloystered}} {{anmov|normal|Supersonic|PS045|Cloystered}} {{anmov|ice|Ice Beam|PS073|Valiant Venomoth!}} {{anmov|ice|Blizzard|PS073|Valiant Venomoth!}} {{anmov/f|ice}} ====Moves improvised==== {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{water color}}; border: 3px solid #{{ice color}}" |- ! Partnered With |- style="background:#FFF" | rowspan="2" | [[File:Lorelei Cloyster Dewgong Ice Missile.png|150px]] | ''[[PS045|Cloystered]]'' | {{m|Spike Cannon}} and {{m|Ice Beam}} | [[Lorelei]]'s {{p|Dewgong}} |- style="background:#FFF" | colspan="3" style="text-align:left" |'''Description: ''' '''Ice Missile''' - A combination of Cloyster's Spike Cannon and Dewgong's Ice Beam, strong enough to penetrate even bedrock. |} {{-}} [[File:Lorelei Cloyster Zensho.png|thumb|150px|Cloyster in Pokémon Zensho]] [[File:Lorelei Cloyster PM.png|thumb|110px|left|Cloyster in Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] ===Pokémon Pocket Monsters=== Lorelei's Cloyster appeared in ''[[PM033|To The Pokémon League]]''. It first appeared along with Lorelei's other Pokémon when Lorelei welcomed {{PPM|Red}} to her school. Jynx used it as a weapon by smacking {{TP|Red|Clefairy}}. Later, it sneaked in Clefairy's food bowl, much to his ire. When Lorelei revealed herself to be an Elite Four member, she and Red had a battle, with Cloyster being the second Pokémon that she sent out. It charged at Clefairy, but Clefairy dodged, causing Cloyster to crash into a wall, being knocked out in the process. ===Pokémon Zensho=== During {{Zensho|Satoshi}}'s time at the Pokémon League in [[PZ10]], Lorelei sends out her Cloyster. Cloyster goes up against Satoshi's {{p|Raichu}} who has the type-disadvantage against the {{type|Electric}}. It wasn't long before Cloyster gets taken out by Raichu's {{m|Thunderbolt}}, advancing Satoshi to the next room. Cloyster was not seen using any moves due to its brief appearance. {{-}} ==In animation== [[File:Lorelei Cloyster.png|thumb|220px|Cloyster in {{aniseries|OS}}]] [[File:Lorelei and Cloyster.png|thumb|220px|left|Cloyster and [[Lorelei|Prima]]]] ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|OS}}==== In ''[[EP099|The Mandarin Island Miss Match]]'', [[Lorelei|Prima]] (Lorelei's name in the {{aniseries|PTS}} [[dub]]) used Cloyster against numerous opponents in a tournament and defeated them all. Eventually, {{Ash}} challenged Prima to a battle. They agreed to use one Pokémon each, and Prima used Cloyster against {{AP|Pikachu}}. Pikachu used a {{m|Thunderbolt}}, but Cloyster shielded itself by {{m|Withdraw}}ing into its shell. Pikachu then used {{m|Agility}}, but Cloyster used {{m|Reflect}} and Pikachu got thrown backward. After getting back on his feet, Pikachu used {{m|Thunder}} to hit Cloyster, who started to glow red after using {{m|Rage}} to enhance its attack power. Pikachu tried to use {{m|Quick Attack}}, but was defeated by an {{m|Aurora Beam}}-{{m|Take Down}} combo, causing Ash to lose. {{-}} ====Personality and characteristics==== Very little is known about Prima's Cloyster, as it and its Trainer have only been in one episode. However, being a Pokémon owned by an Elite Four member, it was shown to be quite strong, as it defeated [[Ash's Pikachu]] despite being at a [[Type#Type effectiveness|type disadvantage]]. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|water|ice|Lorelei Cloyster {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Blizzard|1=Withdraw|2=Reflect}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Blizzard|1=Withdraw|2=Reflect}}|image2=Lorelei Cloyster {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Rage|1=Aurora Beam|2=Take Down}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Rage|1=Aurora Beam|2=Take Down}}}} {{anmov|ice|Blizzard|EP099|The Mandarin Island Miss Match}} {{anmov|water|Withdraw|EP099|The Mandarin Island Miss Match}} {{anmov|psychic|Reflect|EP099|The Mandarin Island Miss Match}} {{anmov|normal|Rage|EP099|The Mandarin Island Miss Match}} {{anmov|ice|Aurora Beam|EP099|The Mandarin Island Miss Match}} {{anmov|normal|Take Down|EP099|The Mandarin Island Miss Match}} {{anmov/f|ice}} ==In the games== Lorelei uses Cloyster in every game she appears in, being her only Pokémon to do so. ===In the [[core series]]=== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{game|Red and Blue|s}}''' |gen=1 |ndex=0091 |pokemon=Cloyster |level=53 |type1=Water|type2=Ice |move1=Supersonic|move1type=Normal |move2=Clamp|move2type=Water |move3=Aurora Beam|move3type=Ice |move4=Spike Cannon|move4type=Normal}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{game|Yellow}}''' |gen=1 |ndex=0091 |pokemon=Cloyster |level=53 |type1=Water|type2=Ice |move1=Supersonic|move1type=Normal |move2=Clamp|move2type=Water |move3=Ice Beam|move3type=Ice |move4=Spike Cannon|move4type=Normal}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{game|FireRed and LeafGreen|s}}
